---
title: "Plate chromosome QC from count matrices"
format: html
execute:
  echo: true
  warning: false
  message: false
---

## Setup

```{r}
# Load libraries
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(readr)
  library(Matrix)
})
```

## Inputs

```{r}
# TODO: Set the folder where your count matrices live
counts_dir <- "C:/Users/Martijn/OneDrive - Radboud Universiteit/Documenten/Projects/Rings_Plates_Gala"

# TODO: List all counts.tsv files and their plate IDs
# Example: c("2104_counts.tsv", "2105_counts.tsv")
count_files <- c(
  "2104_Pfal_counts.tsv",
  "2105_Pfal_counts.tsv",
  "2107_Pfal_counts.tsv",
  "2108_Pfal_counts.tsv",
  "2109_Pfal_counts.tsv",
  "2110_Pfal_counts.tsv",
  "2112_Pfal_counts.tsv"
)

# TODO: Plate labels in the same order as count_files
plate_ids <- c(
  "2104",
  "2105",
  "2107",
  "2108",
  "2109",
  "2110",
  "2112")

# Optional: set where you want to save the Seurat objects
seurat_save_dir <- "C:/Users/Martijn/OneDrive - Radboud Universiteit/Documenten/Projects/Rings_Plates_Gala/seurat_objects2"

# Control vs condition labels (optional, used for ordering or annotation)
plate_group <- c(
  "control",
  "control",
  "condition",
  "condition",
  "condition",
  "condition",
  "control")
```

## Create Seurat objects (no filtering)

```{r}
stopifnot(length(count_files) == length(plate_ids))

seurat_list <- vector("list", length(count_files))

for (i in seq_along(count_files)) {
  file_path <- file.path(counts_dir, count_files[i])

  # Expecting a gene-by-cell matrix with gene IDs in the first column
  counts <- read_tsv(file_path, col_types = cols())
  counts_mat <- as.matrix(counts[ , -1])
  rownames(counts_mat) <- counts[[1]]

  # Create Seurat object without filtering
  seu <- CreateSeuratObject(
    counts = counts_mat,
    project = plate_ids[i],
    min.cells = 0,
    min.features = 0
  )

  # Add plate metadata
  seu$plate_id <- plate_ids[i]
  seu$plate_group <- plate_group[i]

  seurat_list[[i]] <- seu

  # Optional save per-plate object
  if (seurat_save_dir != "PATH/TO/SAVE/SEURAT") {
    saveRDS(seu, file.path(seurat_save_dir, paste0("plate_", plate_ids[i], ".rds")))
  }
}

# Merge for plotting
seu_all <- merge(seurat_list[[1]], y = seurat_list[-1], add.cell.ids = plate_ids)
```

```{r}
grDevices::windows()
Seurat_workflow <- function(seu_all) {
seu_all <- NormalizeData(seu_all, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)
seu_all <- FindVariableFeatures(seu_all, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 700)
all.genes <- rownames(seu_all)
seu_all <- ScaleData(seu_all, features = all.genes)
seu_all <- RunPCA(seu_all)
ElbowPlot(seu_all)
seu_all <- FindNeighbors(seu_all, dims = 1:7)
seu_all <- FindClusters(seu_all, resolution = 0.4)
seu_all <- RunUMAP(seu_all, dims = 1:7, n.components = 2)
DimPlot(seu_all, reduction = "umap", group.by = "seurat_clusters", label = T)
return(seu_all)
}
```

# Identify differentially expressed genes between control rings and KS rings.

```{r}
Idents(Ring146) <- "plate_group"
Ring146 <- JoinLayers(Ring146)
Ring146_marker <- FindMarkers(Ring146, ident.1 = "control", ident.2 = "condition", min.pct = 0.2, logfc.threshold = 1, only.pos = FALSE)

Idents(Ring14) <- "plate_group"
Ring14 <- JoinLayers(Ring14)
Ring14_marker <- FindMarkers(Ring14, ident.1 = "control", ident.2 = "condition", min.pct = 0.2, logfc.threshold = 1, only.pos = FALSE)

aliases_Pf <- read.csv2(file = "C:/Users/Martijn/OneDrive - Radboud Universiteit/Documenten/Projects/ZonMW project/GenetoID_Pf2.csv", header = T, sep = ";") 

annotate_pf_ids <- function(gene_ids, aliases_tbl) {
  x <- tibble(gene_id = gene_ids) %>%
    mutate(
      gene_base = str_remove(gene_id, "\\.\\d+$"),
      has_transcript_suffix = str_detect(gene_id, "\\.\\d+$")
    )

  ann_gene <- aliases_tbl %>%
    select(GeneID_Pf, Product.Description_Pf, Symbol_Pf) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    rename(
      gene_base = GeneID_Pf,
      product_gene = Product.Description_Pf,
      symbol_gene = Symbol_Pf
    )

  ann_tx <- aliases_tbl %>%
    select(TranscriptID_Pf, Product.Description_Pf, Symbol_Pf) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    rename(
      gene_id = TranscriptID_Pf,
      product_tx = Product.Description_Pf,
      symbol_tx = Symbol_Pf
    )

  x %>%
    left_join(ann_tx, by = "gene_id") %>%
    left_join(ann_gene, by = "gene_base") %>%
    mutate(
      product_description = ifelse(has_transcript_suffix, coalesce(product_tx, product_gene), coalesce(product_gene, product_tx)),
      symbol = ifelse(has_transcript_suffix, coalesce(symbol_tx, symbol_gene), coalesce(symbol_gene, symbol_tx))
    ) %>%
    select(gene_id, product_description, symbol)
}

Ring146_marker <- Ring146_marker %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("gene_id") %>%
  left_join(annotate_pf_ids(.$gene_id, aliases_Pf), by = "gene_id") %>%
  relocate(gene_id, product_description, symbol)
write.csv(Ring146_marker, file = "C:/Users/Martijn/OneDrive - Radboud Universiteit/Documenten/Projects/Rings_Plates_Gala/Final/Ring146_CTRLvsKS_markers.csv", row.names = FALSE)

Ring14_marker <- Ring14_marker %>%

  relocate(gene_id, product_description, symbol)
write.csv(Ring14_marker, file = "C:/Users/Martijn/OneDrive - Radboud Universiteit/Documenten/Projects/Rings_Plates_Gala/Final/Ring14_CTRLvsKS_markers.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

# Remove ribosomal genes

```{r}
aliases_file <- "C:/Users/Martijn/OneDrive - Radboud Universiteit/Documenten/Projects/ZonMW project/GenetoID_Pf2.csv"
if (!exists("aliases_Pf") && !exists("aliases")) {
  if (!file.exists(aliases_file)) {
    stop("Aliases file not found at: ", aliases_file)
  }
  aliases_Pf <- read.csv2(file = aliases_file, header = TRUE, sep = ";")
}
aliases_tbl <- if (exists("aliases")) {
  aliases
} else if (exists("aliases_Pf")) {
  aliases_Pf
} else {
  stop("No aliases table found. Please load `aliases` or `aliases_Pf` first.")
}

required_alias_cols <- c("Gene.Type_Pf", "GeneID_Pf", "TranscriptID_Pf")
if (!all(required_alias_cols %in% colnames(aliases_tbl))) {
  stop(
    "Aliases table must contain columns: ",
    paste(required_alias_cols, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

alias_types <- aliases_tbl %>%
  transmute(
    gene_base = as.character(GeneID_Pf),
    transcript_id = as.character(TranscriptID_Pf),
    gene_type_lc = str_to_lower(coalesce(Gene.Type_Pf, ""))
  ) %>%
  distinct()

feature_map <- tibble(
  feature_id = rownames(Ring146),
  gene_base = str_remove(feature_id, "\\.\\d+$")
)

feature_types <- feature_map %>%
  left_join(
    alias_types %>% select(gene_base, gene_type_lc) %>% distinct(),
    by = "gene_base"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    alias_types %>% select(feature_id = transcript_id, gene_type_tx = gene_type_lc) %>% distinct(),
    by = "feature_id"
  ) %>%
  mutate(gene_type_lc = coalesce(gene_type_tx, gene_type_lc))

keep_features <- feature_types %>%
  filter(str_detect(gene_type_lc, "protein")) %>%
  pull(feature_id) %>%
  unique() %>%
  intersect(rownames(Ring146))

if (length(keep_features) == 0) {
  stop("No protein-coding features found in Ring146.")
}

Ring146_ncremove <- subset(Ring146, features = keep_features)
message(
  "Ring146: features ", nrow(Ring146), " -> ",
  nrow(Ring146_ncremove), " (protein-coding only)"
)
saveRDS(Ring146_ncremove, file.path(seurat_save_dir, "Ring146_ncremove.rds"))
```

## Select genes expressed in at least 30% of all parasites, export tables, and build chromosome QC heatmaps

```{r}
export_dir <- file.path(counts_dir, "Final")
if (!dir.exists(export_dir)) dir.create(export_dir, recursive = TRUE)

get_chr_pf <- function(gene_id) {
  m <- str_match(gene_id, "^PF3D7-(\\d{2})")
  if (!is.na(m[, 2])) return(paste0("chr", m[, 2]))
  NA_character_
}

chr_sort_index <- function(chr_vec) {
  num <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(str_remove(chr_vec, "^chr")))
  ifelse(is.na(num), Inf, num)
}

get_assay_data_safe <- function(seu_obj, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts") {
  out <- tryCatch(GetAssayData(seu_obj, assay = assay, layer = layer), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(out)) {
    slot_name <- ifelse(layer == "data", "data", "counts")
    out <- tryCatch(GetAssayData(seu_obj, assay = assay, slot = slot_name), error = function(e) NULL)
  }
  if (is.null(out)) stop("Could not retrieve ", layer, " matrix from Seurat object.")
  out
}

build_combined_heatmap <- function(df, status_col, white_label, black_label) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    warning("No rows available to build heatmap.")
    return(NULL)
  }

  cell_levels <- df %>%
    distinct(cell, plate_group, plate_id) %>%
    mutate(
      group_order = case_when(
        plate_group == "Control" ~ 1L,
        plate_group == "Condition (KS)" ~ 2L,
        TRUE ~ 3L
      )
    ) %>%
    arrange(group_order, plate_id, cell) %>%
    pull(cell)

  chrom_levels <- unique(df$chrom[order(chr_sort_index(df$chrom), df$chrom)])

  plot_df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      fill_status = factor(.data[[status_col]], levels = c(white_label, black_label)),
      x_idx = match(cell, cell_levels),
      y_idx = match(chrom, chrom_levels)
    )

  annotation_df <- df %>%
    distinct(cell, plate_group) %>%
    mutate(
      x_idx = match(cell, cell_levels),
      group_fill = case_when(
        plate_group == "Control" ~ "Control",
        plate_group == "Condition (KS)" ~ "Condition (KS)",
        TRUE ~ "Other"
      )
    )

  heatmap_plot <- ggplot() +
    geom_tile(
      data = plot_df,
      aes(x = x_idx, y = y_idx, fill = fill_status),
      color = "white",
      linewidth = 0.15,
      width = 1,
      height = 1
    ) +
    geom_segment(
      data = annotation_df,
      aes(
        x = x_idx - 0.5,
        xend = x_idx + 0.5,
        y = 0.5,
        yend = 0.5,
        color = group_fill
      ),
      linewidth = 1.2,
      lineend = "butt"
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = setNames(c("white", "black"), c(white_label, black_label)),
      breaks = c(white_label, black_label),
      labels = c(white_label, black_label),
      drop = FALSE,
      name = "Status"
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c("Control" = "grey70", "Condition (KS)" = "black", "Other" = "grey40"),
      guide = "none"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(0.5, length(cell_levels) + 0.5),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    scale_y_reverse(
      limits = c(length(chrom_levels) + 0.5, 0),
      breaks = seq_along(chrom_levels),
      labels = chrom_levels,
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    labs(x = "Parasites (cells)", y = "Chromosome") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
      panel.grid = element_blank()
    )

  list(
    heatmap_plot = heatmap_plot,
    n_cells = length(cell_levels),
    n_chrom = length(chrom_levels)
  )
}

print_stitched_heatmap <- function(hm_obj, figure_title, open_window = TRUE, min_height = 5, max_height = 24, per_chrom = 0.35) {
  if (is.null(hm_obj)) {
    warning("Cannot render stitched heatmap; heatmap object is NULL.")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  target_height <- max(min_height, min(max_height, 2.5 + hm_obj$n_chrom * per_chrom))
  target_width <- max(12, min(28, 4 + hm_obj$n_cells * 0.03))

  draw_single <- function() {
    print(
      hm_obj$heatmap_plot +
        ggtitle(figure_title) +
        theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))
    )
  }

  if (isTRUE(open_window) && interactive()) {
    tryCatch(
      {
        if (.Platform$OS.type == "windows") {
          grDevices::windows(width = target_width, height = target_height)
        } else {
          grDevices::dev.new(width = target_width, height = target_height)
        }
        draw_single()
      },
      error = function(e) {
        message("Could not open interactive graphics window: ", conditionMessage(e))
      }
    )
  }

  if (requireNamespace("knitr", quietly = TRUE)) {
    old_height <- knitr::opts_current$get("fig.height")
    old_width <- knitr::opts_current$get("fig.width")
    knitr::opts_current$set(fig.height = target_height, fig.width = target_width)
    draw_single()
    knitr::opts_current$set(fig.height = old_height, fig.width = old_width)
  } else {
    draw_single()
  }

  invisible(list(n_cells = hm_obj$n_cells, n_chrom = hm_obj$n_chrom))
}

run_chr_qc_for_object <- function(seu_obj, obj_label) {
  seu_for_chr <- tryCatch(JoinLayers(seu_obj), error = function(e) seu_obj)

  counts_mat <- get_assay_data_safe(seu_for_chr, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")

  data_mat <- tryCatch(
    get_assay_data_safe(seu_for_chr, assay = "RNA", layer = "data"),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (is.null(data_mat)) {
    seu_for_chr <- NormalizeData(
      seu_for_chr,
      assay = "RNA",
      normalization.method = "LogNormalize",
      scale.factor = 10000,
      verbose = FALSE
    )
    data_mat <- get_assay_data_safe(seu_for_chr, assay = "RNA", layer = "data")
  }

  meta_tmp <- seu_for_chr@meta.data %>%
    mutate(cell = rownames(seu_for_chr@meta.data)) %>%
    select(cell, plate_id, plate_group)

  if (!all(c("cell", "plate_id", "plate_group") %in% colnames(meta_tmp))) {
    stop("Metadata must contain: cell, plate_id, plate_group")
  }

  meta_tmp <- meta_tmp %>%
    mutate(
      plate_group_raw = as.character(plate_group),
      plate_group_norm = str_to_lower(str_squish(plate_group_raw)),
      plate_group = case_when(
        str_detect(plate_group_norm, "control") ~ "Control",
        str_detect(plate_group_norm, "condition|ks") ~ "Condition (KS)",
        TRUE ~ plate_group_raw
      )
    ) %>%
    select(cell, plate_id, plate_group)

  message("=== ", obj_label, " ===")
  print(meta_tmp %>% count(plate_group, name = "n_cells"))

  gene_detect_frac <- Matrix::rowSums(counts_mat > 0) / ncol(counts_mat)
  genes_keep <- names(gene_detect_frac)[gene_detect_frac >= 0.30]
  if (length(genes_keep) == 0) {
    stop("No genes are expressed in at least 30% of all parasites for ", obj_label)
  }

  counts_30 <- counts_mat[genes_keep, , drop = FALSE]
  data_30 <- data_mat[genes_keep, , drop = FALSE]

  gene_chr_map <- tibble(
    gene = rownames(counts_30),
    chrom = vapply(rownames(counts_30), get_chr_pf, character(1))
  ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(chrom)) %>%
    mutate(chr_idx = chr_sort_index(chrom)) %>%
    arrange(chr_idx, chrom, gene) %>%
    select(-chr_idx)

  if (nrow(gene_chr_map) == 0) {
    stop("No PF3D7 chromosome-mappable genes remain after 30% filtering for ", obj_label)
  }

  genes_per_chr <- gene_chr_map %>%
    count(chrom, name = "n_genes_after_30pct") %>%
    mutate(chr_idx = chr_sort_index(chrom)) %>%
    arrange(chr_idx, chrom) %>%
    select(-chr_idx)
  print(genes_per_chr)

  chr_gene_sets <- split(gene_chr_map$gene, gene_chr_map$chrom)
  detected_by_chr <- lapply(chr_gene_sets, function(genes) {
    Matrix::colSums(counts_30[genes, , drop = FALSE] > 0)
  })

  chr_detect_mat <- do.call(rbind, detected_by_chr)
  chr_detect_mat <- chr_detect_mat[order(chr_sort_index(rownames(chr_detect_mat)), rownames(chr_detect_mat)), , drop = FALSE]

  detected_by_chr_df <- as.data.frame(t(chr_detect_mat), check.names = FALSE)
  detected_by_chr_df$cell <- rownames(detected_by_chr_df)

  heatmap_base <- detected_by_chr_df %>%
    pivot_longer(-cell, names_to = "chrom", values_to = "detected_genes") %>%
    left_join(genes_per_chr, by = "chrom") %>%
    left_join(meta_tmp, by = "cell") %>%
    filter(!is.na(plate_group), !is.na(plate_id)) %>%
    mutate(
      status_zero = ifelse(detected_genes == 0, "Zero counts", "Detected"),
      status_one = ifelse(detected_genes <= 1, "<=1 gene detected", ">1 gene detected"),
      status_two = ifelse(detected_genes <= 2, "<=2 genes detected", ">2 genes detected"),
      status_one_ten = ifelse(detected_genes < (n_genes_after_30pct / 10), "<1/10 genes detected", ">=1/10 genes detected")
    )

  chr_keep_gt10 <- genes_per_chr %>%
    filter(n_genes_after_30pct > 10) %>%
    pull(chrom)

  hm_df <- heatmap_base %>% filter(chrom %in% chr_keep_gt10)
  if (nrow(hm_df) == 0) {
    warning("No chromosomes with >10 genes after 30% filter for ", obj_label)
  }

  cell_order <- meta_tmp %>%
    arrange(plate_group, plate_id, cell) %>%
    pull(cell)
  cell_conditions <- meta_tmp$plate_group[match(cell_order, meta_tmp$cell)]

  chr_counts_export <- as.data.frame(chr_detect_mat[, cell_order, drop = FALSE], check.names = FALSE) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("Chromosome") %>%
    mutate(across(-Chromosome, as.character))

  condition_row_chr <- tibble(Chromosome = "Condition")
  for (i in seq_along(cell_order)) {
    condition_row_chr[[cell_order[i]]] <- cell_conditions[i]
  }
  chr_counts_export <- bind_rows(condition_row_chr, chr_counts_export)
  write.csv(
    chr_counts_export,
    file = file.path(export_dir, paste0(obj_label, "_chromosome_detected_genes_per_cell_30pct.csv")),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  gene_order <- gene_chr_map %>% distinct(chrom, gene)
  gene_ids_ordered <- gene_order$gene
  lognorm_mat <- data_30[gene_ids_ordered, cell_order, drop = FALSE]
  lognorm_export <- as.data.frame(as.matrix(lognorm_mat), check.names = FALSE) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("GeneID") %>%
    left_join(gene_order, by = c("GeneID" = "gene")) %>%
    relocate(chrom, .before = GeneID) %>%
    mutate(across(-c(chrom, GeneID), as.character))

  condition_row_gene <- tibble(chrom = "Condition", GeneID = "Condition")
  for (i in seq_along(cell_order)) {
    condition_row_gene[[cell_order[i]]] <- cell_conditions[i]
  }
  lognorm_export <- bind_rows(condition_row_gene, lognorm_export)
  write.csv(
    lognorm_export,
    file = file.path(export_dir, paste0(obj_label, "_lognorm_counts_genes_30pct_ordered_by_chromosome.csv")),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  hm_zero <- build_combined_heatmap(
    df = hm_df,
    status_col = "status_zero",
    white_label = "Detected",
    black_label = "Zero counts"
  )
  hm_one <- build_combined_heatmap(
    df = hm_df,
    status_col = "status_one",
    white_label = ">1 gene detected",
    black_label = "<=1 gene detected"
  )
  hm_two <- build_combined_heatmap(
    df = hm_df,
    status_col = "status_two",
    white_label = ">2 genes detected",
    black_label = "<=2 genes detected"
  )
  hm_one_ten <- build_combined_heatmap(
    df = hm_df,
    status_col = "status_one_ten",
    white_label = ">=1/10 genes detected",
    black_label = "<1/10 genes detected"
  )

  print_stitched_heatmap(
    hm_obj = hm_zero,
    figure_title = paste0(obj_label, " | chromosomes >10 genes | black = zero genes detected")
  )
  print_stitched_heatmap(
    hm_obj = hm_one,
    figure_title = paste0(obj_label, " | chromosomes >10 genes | black = <=1 gene detected")
  )
  print_stitched_heatmap(
    hm_obj = hm_two,
    figure_title = paste0(obj_label, " | chromosomes >10 genes | black = <=2 genes detected")
  )
  print_stitched_heatmap(
    hm_obj = hm_one_ten,
    figure_title = paste0(obj_label, " | chromosomes >10 genes | black = <1/10 genes detected")
  )

  list(
    genes_keep = genes_keep,
    genes_per_chromosome = genes_per_chr,
    chr_keep_gt10 = chr_keep_gt10,
    heatmap_data = hm_df,
    heatmaps = list(
      zero = hm_zero,
      one = hm_one,
      two = hm_two,
      one_ten = hm_one_ten
    ),
    export_files = list(
      chromosome_detected_genes_per_cell = file.path(export_dir, paste0(obj_label, "_chromosome_detected_genes_per_cell_30pct.csv")),
      lognorm_counts_genes = file.path(export_dir, paste0(obj_label, "_lognorm_counts_genes_30pct_ordered_by_chromosome.csv"))
    )
  )
}

ring146_chr_qc <- run_chr_qc_for_object(Ring146_ncremove, "Ring146_ncremove")
ring146_chr_qc$genes_per_chromosome
ring146_chr_qc$export_files

saveRDS(ring146_chr_qc, file.path(seurat_save_dir, "Ring146_ncremove_chr_qc_results.rds"))
```
